title: Lodestone Backport
description: A data pack that adds the new lodestone crafting recipe to previous versions of the game
body:
# Lodestone Backport

Free and open-source datapack for Minecraft 1.21 until 1.21.4 that introduice the new lodestone crafting recipe which was added in snapshot 25w02aa for the Spring to Life 1.21.5 update

## Features

Adds the recipe of the lodestone with iron ingot instead of netherite ingot
